definitions.explanation: A person or group sent on a diplomatic or official mission to represent their country or organization. Also refers to the mission itself.

examples.japanese: {使節|しせつ}を{派遣|はけん}する。
{外交|がいこう}{使節|しせつ}が{来日|らいにち}した。
{遣唐使|けんとうし}は{日本|にほん}から{中国|ちゅうごく}へ{送|おく}られた{使節|しせつ}だった。
examples.english: The kentoshi were envoys sent from Japan to China.

notes:
A formal, somewhat literary term often encountered in history and diplomatic contexts. Different from the homophone {施設|しせつ} (facility).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{外交|がいこう}{使節|しせつ} (diplomatic envoy)
・{使節|しせつ}{団|だん} (delegation, diplomatic mission group)
・{特使|とくし} / {特別|とくべつ}{使節|しせつ} (special envoy)
・{使節|しせつ}を{派遣|はけん}する (send an envoy)
・{使節|しせつ}を{迎|むか}える (receive an envoy)

HISTORICAL USAGE:
Often seen in Japanese history: {遣唐使|けんとうし} (envoys to Tang China), {遣隋使|けんずいし} (envoys to Sui China), {天正遣欧使節|てんしょうけんおうしせつ} (Tensho embassy to Europe).

cross_references.notes: 施設 (しせつ) means facility — same reading, different meaning
